name: lighting_pass_template
description: G-3: a lighting pass built in Studio from the Deferred lighting starting point. Add fullscreen pass after the engine's lighting pass; the pass reads the five G-buffer targets and writes the lit colour the viewport shows; New... with Deferred lighting names the pass, writes a shader that reads them and the scene lights, and turns on Uses scene lights and Camera position for the pass. Saved, the viewport shows the box lit by the scene's one light: not one colour. The light loop of the shader cut in the author's editor, the picture goes black; restored, the lit box comes back.
